pk: tatvapradipika asangatvan paranatnana uktan ‘atanovayvanakasanasanganarasan’ ityaksarabrahnane ‘ॐ susuptyutkrantyorBedena ॐ’ asangatsvapnadidraswurisvarajivasya Bedavyapesana jivosanga api tu para evasanga aTa ca parajivasya Bedavyapadesana jiva para eva san asanga atra hi ‘tadyaTa priyaya striya sanparisvakto na bahyan kincana veda nantaranevayan purusa prajnena’ ityadina ‘tadyatan nasusanahitanutsarjadyadevanevayan sariran atna prajnenatnana’ ityadina ca sadrswantan Bedo vyapadisyate na cayanaBiDiyanano jivesaBedo vyavaharika iti vacyan tadarTanirupanat anirvacyasya nirastatvat Bedasya cabaDat na ca vyavaharasanbanDitvan vyavaharikatvan, taTavyavaharikasyapi brahnana satyatvat avyavaharikatve prativadi-dusitepi brahnani nukatapateriti
ck: tatvapratipika asankatvan paranatnana uktan ‘atanovayvanakasanasankanarasan’ ityaksaraprahnane ‘ॐ susuptyutkrantyorpetena ॐ’ asankatsvapnatitrasturisvaracivasya petavyapesana civosanka api tu para evasanka ata ca paracivasya petavyapatesana civa para eva san asanka atra hi ‘tatyata priyaya striya sanparisvakto na pahyan kincana veta nantaranevayan purusa pracnena’ ityatina ‘tatyatan nasusanahitanutsarcatyatevanevayan sariran atna pracnenatnana’ ityatina ca satrstantan peto vyapatisyate na cayanapitiyanano civesapeto vyavaharika iti vacyan tatartanirupanat anirvacyasya nirastatvat petasya capatat na ca vyavaharasanpantitvan vyavaharikatvan, tatavyavaharikasyapi prahnana satyatvat avyavaharikatve prativati-tusitepi prahnani nukatapateriti

pk: tatvapradipika ‘patin visvasyatnesvaran sasvatan’ ityadina nityanahina parasyokta sa brahnanasyapi pratiyate virincasya kadacitkapadaprapterna nityanahinetyasankyaha– devanan ceti cakarovaDarane anyadevananeva vidyakarnano sakasatpadaprapti sucita devataDikarane na virincasya tasnadvirincopi nityanahineti prapta aha ॐ patyadisabdeBya ॐ patisabdadisanasabdadagrahyasrutatvadisabdeByasca nityanahitvenokto brahnano visnureva brahnana vedena ganyata iti ‘brahnana’, brahna anati vacyatveneti va ana gataviti Dato ‘utanrtatvasyesana’ ityadina ‘purusa evedan’ iti pratijnate sarvesatve heturucyate anrtasya nuktasyapisanoyan purusa iti yatasnadidan sarvan purusa eva purusaDinanevetyarTa na ca sarvasya purusEkyanihocyate taTasatyanivrterayuktesca tasnatadaDinatvaneva pratijnatan purusenEvedan vyaptaniti varTa taTa ca pEngisrutirinan srutin vyacaswe ‘purusa evedan sarvan yadButan yaca Bavyaniti purusenEvedan vyaptan yadButan yaca Bavyan atrnadakarisatsarvan Bagavaniti niTya-drswiresa’ iti ‘sarvan sanapnoti tatosi sarva’ iti ca Bagavadgitasu ‘yadanenatirohati’ ityanasabdokto nartyasansari etadatroktan Bavati nuktasanudayasyapiso visnu yadayan sansarisanudayanatyagat yadyayan nuktiganananisa syat, nEva sansarina sansaranocayet nocayati ca, tasnanuktananapisa eva ‘sadanrtasyaBayasyeso nartyananan yadatyagat’ iti ca Bagavate anrtatvasyeti DarnaDarnyaBedaBiprayena anrtatvasyesana iti varTa nukterapi tadaDinatvat iti sritrivikranapanqitacaryaviracitayan brahnasutraBasyawikayan praTanaDyayasya trtiya pada
ck: tatvapratipika ‘patin visvasyatnesvaran sasvatan’ ityatina nityanahina parasyokta sa prahnanasyapi pratiyate virincasya katacitkapataprapterna nityanahinetyasankyaha– tevanan ceti cakarovatarane anyatevananeva vityakarnano sakasatpataprapti sucita tevatatikarane na virincasya tasnatvirincopi nityanahineti prapta aha ॐ patyatisaptepya ॐ patisaptatisanasaptatakrahyasrutatvatisaptepyasca nityanahitvenokto prahnano visnureva prahnana vetena kanyata iti ‘prahnana’, prahna anati vacyatveneti va ana kataviti tato ‘utanrtatvasyesana’ ityatina ‘purusa evetan’ iti praticnate sarvesatve heturucyate anrtasya nuktasyapisanoyan purusa iti yatasnatitan sarvan purusa eva purusatinanevetyarta na ca sarvasya purusEkyanihocyate tatasatyanivrterayuktesca tasnatatatinatvaneva praticnatan purusenEvetan vyaptaniti varta tata ca pEnkisrutirinan srutin vyacaste ‘purusa evetan sarvan yatputan yaca pavyaniti purusenEvetan vyaptan yatputan yaca pavyan atrnatakarisatsarvan pakavaniti nitya-trstiresa’ iti ‘sarvan sanapnoti tatosi sarva’ iti ca pakavatkitasu ‘yatanenatirohati’ ityanasaptokto nartyasansari etatatroktan pavati nuktasanutayasyapiso visnu yatayan sansarisanutayanatyakat yatyayan nuktikanananisa syat, nEva sansarina sansaranocayet nocayati ca, tasnanuktananapisa eva ‘satanrtasyapayasyeso nartyananan yatatyakat’ iti ca pakavate anrtatvasyeti tarnatarnyapetapiprayena anrtatvasyesana iti varta nukterapi tatatinatvat iti sritrivikranapantitacaryaviracitayan prahnasutrapasyatikayan pratanatyayasya trtiya pata
s: तत्त्वप्रदीपिका ‘पतिं विश्वस्याऽत्मेश्वरं शाश्वतम्’ इत्यादिना नित्यमहिमा परस्योक्तः स ब्राह्मणस्यापि प्रतीयते विरिञ्चस्य कादाचित्कपदप्राप्ते

pk: tatvapradipika ‘nahata paranavyaktanavyaktatpurusa para’ iti kaWakanan saKayanavyaktasabdena praDanan paripaWyate tasya nahata paratvatpurusadavaratvaca na hyavaratvan parasya kayapi viDaya pasyana ityasanka pariharaBasyasyayanarTa tasyEva visno sarirarupanavyaktan tadaDinatvacCariraniva rupanasyeti sarirarupan, na tu haresariratvatasyeti sarirarupanityuktan na ca sarirakalpanayogyan taditi kapratyayena kutsayanasa tasninavyakte niyanakatvena vartanano visnurevavyaktasabdena grhyate paranatnana evavyaktasabdo nuKya tatantratvena tadavarakatvena ca tacCarirarupakatvadi-tarasyavyaktasabda ‘tucCa’nalpan gunata paranapeksayalpatvan prakrte a sanantadBunatna-katvadaBu brahna yat brahna prakrtyapihitanasit tadeva ‘tapaso’ jnanasya nahataya praDananasit avyaktaniti jnatunasusakan, acalan na calyan, santan purnasuKan, niskalan soqasakalavarjitan, niskriyan na kriyata iti
ck: tatvapratipika ‘nahata paranavyaktanavyaktatpurusa para’ iti katakanan sakayanavyaktasaptena pratanan paripatyate tasya nahata paratvatpurusatavaratvaca na hyavaratvan parasya kayapi vitaya pasyana ityasanka pariharapasyasyayanarta tasyEva visno sarirarupanavyaktan tatatinatvacariraniva rupanasyeti sarirarupan, na tu haresariratvatasyeti sarirarupanityuktan na ca sarirakalpanayokyan tatiti kapratyayena kutsayanasa tasninavyakte niyanakatvena vartanano visnurevavyaktasaptena krhyate paranatnana evavyaktasapto nukya tatantratvena tatavarakatvena ca tacarirarupakatvati-tarasyavyaktasapta ‘tuca’nalpan kunata paranapeksayalpatvan prakrte a sanantatpunatna-katvatapu prahna yat prahna prakrtyapihitanasit tateva ‘tapaso’ cnanasya nahataya pratananasit avyaktaniti cnatunasusakan, acalan na calyan, santan purnasukan, niskalan sotasakalavarcitan, niskriyan na kriyata iti
s: तत्त्वप्रदीपिका ‘महतः परमव्यक्तमव्यक्तात्पुरुषः परः’ इति काठकानां शाखायामव्यक्तशब्देन प्रधानं परिपठ्यते तस्य महतः परत्वात्पुरुषादवरत्वाच्च न

pk: tatvapradipika vasante vasante jyotisa yajetetyadikarnadyaBiDayakasya padakadanbakasya pratyekan brahna-vacakatvan na yujyate kartrkaranakarnakranadivacanaviroDat nuKyata ekasyoBayarTatvasanBavena tadvacanaBave krtyanusWanalopaprasangadityata aha – ‘jyotirupakranatu taTa hyaDiyata eke’ jyotiswonadikarnakartrkaranadinanasesanan padarTanan vacakatvena prasidDasabdananaBiDeyopi sa eva yaTa cayan sarvasabdavacyo Bavati taTa hyaDiyata eke saKina praGawakopakranadevaraBya ayan srutyarTa – esa paranatna inan dehan lokan jivantaryanirupenaByarcat ya esa aditya-stapati, ‘yascasavaditye’ ‘aTa ya esontara aditye hiranyasnasru’ ‘yenadityastapati tejasa Brajasa ca’ ‘yadadityagatan teja’ ityadi srutisnrtiByo visnureva hi tatrasTastapati sarvapraneta hyesa yastapati satan varsani tan lokanaByarcaditi yatasnacCatarcina ityacaksate vidvansa etaneva satarcina santan satarcina ityacaksate na tvanyaniti evananyanananyapi paranatnani prTakprTanirucya punasarvavedapraBrtaya sanudraGosanta sabda ekavisayayEva vyahrti sa ca sarvapranetrparanatnavisayEveti vidyaditi satatparyanaDiyate niKilapadanan tadvacakatvapadavi tu guruBirevopasandarsayitun susaketi nasnaBiratra prayatyate darsita ca sa Bangi BagavatEvanuvyaKyane– ‘jatanotan harO yasnajyoti sa pranarupata ayajetascayajeto vasantisca vasanstata’ ityadika
ck: tatvapratipika vasante vasante cyotisa yacetetyatikarnatyapitayakasya patakatanpakasya pratyekan prahna-vacakatvan na yucyate kartrkaranakarnakranativacanavirotat nukyata ekasyopayartatvasanpavena tatvacanapave krtyanustanalopaprasankatityata aha – ‘cyotirupakranatu tata hyatiyata eke’ cyotistonatikarnakartrkaranatinanasesanan patartanan vacakatvena prasitasaptananapiteyopi sa eva yata cayan sarvasaptavacyo pavati tata hyatiyata eke sakina prakatakopakranatevarapya ayan srutyarta – esa paranatna inan tehan lokan civantaryanirupenapyarcat ya esa atitya-stapati, ‘yascasavatitye’ ‘ata ya esontara atitye hiranyasnasru’ ‘yenatityastapati tecasa pracasa ca’ ‘yatatityakatan teca’ ityati srutisnrtipyo visnureva hi tatrastastapati sarvapraneta hyesa yastapati satan varsani tan lokanapyarcatiti yatasnacatarcina ityacaksate vitvansa etaneva satarcina santan satarcina ityacaksate na tvanyaniti evananyanananyapi paranatnani prtakprtanirucya punasarvavetapraprtaya sanutrakosanta sapta ekavisayayEva vyahrti sa ca sarvapranetrparanatnavisayEveti vityatiti satatparyanatiyate nikilapatanan tatvacakatvapatavi tu kurupirevopasantarsayitun susaketi nasnapiratra prayatyate tarsita ca sa panki pakavatEvanuvyakyane– ‘catanotan harO yasnacyoti sa pranarupata ayacetascayaceto vasantisca vasanstata’ ityatika

pk: tatvapradipika prasanadguro sravanan kartavyanityuktan tatra guruprasado va sravanadisvaprayatno va balavaniti nirupyate lingaBuyastvatadDi baliyastadapi guro prasadapurvakan pradananeva balavat satyakana-brahnana upakosalabrahnane ca tatra linganan Buyastvat ‘tanupaniya krsananabalanan catusata ga nirakrtyovacEtasOnyanusanvrajeti, ta aBiprasTapayanuvaca nasahasrenavarteyeti, sa ha varsaganan provasa’ ityupanitanatrasya satyakanasya vinapyaDyayanena guruprasadane pravrte ‘aTa hEnanrsaBoByuvada’ ‘brahnana sonya te padan bravaniti’ ‘tanagniraByuvada’ ‘tan hansa upanipatyaByuvada’ ‘tan nadgurupanipatyaByuvada’ityadina vrsaBaviswadvayoragne pratyaksadDansarupadbrahnano nadgurupadvarunaca svayanevaBiBasya tatvopadesalaBateByo jnanadigunakan brahna jnatvapi satyakanena tesvasusrusadiBayadBagavanstveva neBiswaya bruyaditi vacanat, upanayanadikarturacaryadaraDitalabDa vidya hi saDakatanatvan prapnotiti vacanat, tan canujnanaBipsun prati ‘atra ha na kincana viyaya’ityacaryasyanujnanat, deveBya srutva na kincidapi haniraBavadityarTa, upakosalavacanaca, ayanarTa– ‘tan jayovaca tapto brahnacari kusalanagninparicacarina tvagnaya paripravocan prabruhyasnE’ iti bahuvarsan guruprasadanarTanagninparicarata upakosalasyarTe satyakanan prati jayavacanat, aprocya prosite ca tasnin ‘tapto brahnacari kusalan na paricacaridDantasnE prabravana’ ityuktva ‘prano brahna kan brahna Kan brahna’ ityupakosalayagninan vacanat, ‘aTa hEnan garhapatyonusasasa’ ‘ya esa aditye puruso drsyate sohanasni’ityadO ca pratyekan tesan tasna eva vacanat, ‘acaryastu te gatin vakta’ityacaryanujnanarTan ca vacanadityevan lingaBuyastvadguruprasada eva balavan
